# SD13-E4-F7 deterministic Human Bard level 1 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard level 1 identity as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It
# preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and stays a
# single-class, level-1-only spell-bearing baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every Bard-class-feature surface and every spell-support surface:
# no Bardic Knowledge check resolution, no Bardic Music / Inspire Courage execution, no
# Bard spell selections, no spells known, no spells per day, no spell DCs, no bonus spells,
# no prepared posture, no school choice, and no general spell totals. It adds only the
# minimum choice data needed to make the Bard class identity, the named Bardic Knowledge
# and Bardic Music chassis-class-feature burden, and the spontaneous known-spell / slot
# posture burden legible; those burdens are intentionally left for the runtime and matrix
# to name as still blocking.
